stem: A humidity sensor is mounted directly in the path of a humidifier discharge and is used to represent the entire room. What is the main concern?
choices: The sensor may be sampling a localized moisture plume rather than conditions representative of the crop canopy
The sensor may respond too slowly because humidifier discharge reduces the normal temperature response of its humidity element
The sensor may report the room average accurately but make it harder to compare humidity with measurements taken near return-air locations
The sensor may primarily reflect humidifier duty cycle, which is acceptable if the controller also uses a separate air-temperature measurement
rationale: Sensors should represent the conditions relevant to the crop. Direct exposure to a localized source can bias readings and should be evaluated before those data drive room-wide decisions.
